groups.saying_opens: كنت أخدم النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

notes: Two sayings, each with its own isnad, both stored (owner ruling 6): saying 1 is Abu al-Sumah's account of the Prophet's washing and the infant's urine; saying 2 is Hasan's ruling, transmitted by Harun ibn Tamim («قال هارون بن تميم عن الحسن»)
«قال عباس حدثنا يحيى بن الوليد» names the same man as the chain: not a variant
«قال أبو داود وهو أبو الزعراء» is the compiler's identification of Yahya: not used (rule 9)
«- المعنى -» is an editor gloss: left out
